entries.reason: the central (charon_bluetooth_activate_all_connections, MIDIBluetooth16.m) has never run: no BLE MIDI device on a device, and the emulated 4S has no Bluetooth. Its scan, connect and framing are unmeasured on hardware; a built symbol under this name would answer for code that has not run, so the name is not exported.
entries.effect: a call to MIDIBluetoothDriverActivateAllConnections does not link on this release until a device run makes the row implemented.
entries.source: the 26.2 header for the contract (MIDIBluetoothConnection.h); macOS CoreMIDI for the return value (tests/backports/host/coremidi/oracle/bluetooth.m)

entries.reason: the disconnect (charon_bluetooth_disconnect, MIDIBluetooth16.m) has never run on a device: the key it matches a device by (CFUUIDCreateString on 6.1.3) is unmeasured against the release's own UUID string. Not exported under this name until a device run.
entries.effect: a call to MIDIBluetoothDriverDisconnect does not link on this release until a device run makes the row implemented.
entries.source: the 26.2 header for the contract (MIDIBluetoothConnection.h); macOS CoreMIDI for the return values (tests/backports/host/coremidi/oracle/bluetooth.m)
